credits_text: CINEMA SCAPE STUDIOS PRESENTS A ANTHONY RAUS FILM. "NORTH WOODS". STARRING JESSE BOONE, ERIN HARWOOD, AMBER ALLEN, PHIL IPPOLITO, JAN BLAKE SALAZAR AND JACOB BATALON. PRODUCED BY ANTHONY RAUS AND JAN BLAKE SALAZAR. WRITTEN AND DIRECTED BY ANTHONY RAUS.
